The starting point

Snapshot of the current Player drawing code. Its head and limbs extend beyond its 60 × 40 base bounds; the new candidates fit their stated art envelope.

The supplied reference

Borrow its armor construction, material contrast, and focal accents. Preserve our six-legged identity. The tiny rider is omitted from this pass.

What this proves

Silhouette, material direction, and small-scale readability. These are editable Canvas concepts, not final illustration assets.

The yellow envelope is an art guide, not a proposed collision box. Enlarging the horse requires gameplay review in stage 2. The frozen scene comes from the existing Background renderer; enemies and platforms are not composited here.

No game runtime files have changed. No live data records are involved, so a data manifest is not needed.

Start with A. Borrow C’s restraint.

My recommendation: plated steel, with fewer seams at small sizes. Review the 90 × 60 option before deciding whether the extra screen space is worth it.

A → reference fidelityLayered steel and mechanical weight.
B → speedLong lines and a sharper profile.
C → arcade clarityBold masses and fewer small details.
